text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, at Sakura Laurel's request, we invited
the other two members of the Victory Club
to take some photos together.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
They wanted to show their parents, who had watched over
all three of them since their club days, just how much
they had grown as they wore their racing silks.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"This is the training ground I used back in my club days!
Hehe, it brings back memories.
It's barely changed since then!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"...And this is from Chiyo-chan!
'Hello, are you arriving soon?'"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: ...Huh? Did you get lost?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Waaah, I'm sorryyy!
I was just trying to help guide a lost old lady home, that's all~!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
To think that we, the guides, would end up getting lost!
This is the blunder of my life!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Now, now, it happens to the best of us.
We found it safe and sound, so no harm done—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Chowaah!? A sunshower!?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Oh no, let's take shelter from the rain over there!
Everyone, follow me!

text_block_list.name: Chiyo & Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Yes, Laurel-san!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The three rushed hurriedly down the muddy mountain trail.
Worried that it was far too dangerous,
I moved to stop them, but—

text_block_list.name: The Three
text_block_list.text:
Eeeek!?
Whoooaa!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: All three of them tumbled down together...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Ouch...! Sorry, Chiyo-chan,
Baku-chan. Are you two hurt?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Yes, my body is fine!
However, my clothes are...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Ah...!
Everyone really is covered in mud.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
At this rate, the photos will... 
Mmh...
choice_data_list: Getting covered in mud isn't all bad.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Achoo!
Ah, excuse me!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
You're right...
We can't afford to let them catch a cold, after all.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, let's change our plans!
How about we head back once, change into tracksuits,
and shoot on the academy's track... what do you think?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, we returned to the academy
and took a photo in our tracksuits.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, that turned out great!
Thanks for cooperating, everyone♪

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
...?
Why the long face, Chiyo-chan?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Um... I was just wondering if Laurel-san was able to photograph what she truly wanted to.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: "Because honestly, you wanted to take a picture there looking sharp in your racing silks, didn't you?"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, thanks, Chiyo-chan.
Don't worry, I'm okay!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Sure, at first I really wanted to take a picture of you in your racing silks, but... don't you think this photo looks great too?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Running on this track,
wearing this jersey.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
It's so authentic and down-to-earth,
filled with our everyday lives, wouldn't you say?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
I think this photo is absolutely perfect
for showing who we are right now!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Afterward, when I sent the photos we took to my parents, they sent back a letter filled with joy.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
You're so right, Laurel-san!
"Everyone's working hard at that academy right now," huh?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, to think you'd be this happy.
I'm so glad I sent it!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Being covered in mud is also...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Fufu!
That's right, I think so too!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? You're covered in mud!?
That doesn't look sharp at all!?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"Even so, I figured it's fine! I wanted them
to see how grown-up I've become, but—"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
“Still, we're all still growing.
We're just kids who lose our way and stumble sometimes.”

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"If we want to show things just as they are right now,
being covered in mud isn't a bad look, right?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, we hurried over
to the old sports ground, and—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, Laurel-san,
your smile is even more wonderful than usual!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: "Because back in the day, getting covered in mud with everyone else was something I could hardly ever do."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: All I can do is watch over her from afar...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"So looking at how strong you've become now...
It just makes me so happy!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: I'm sure my parents will be thrilled too!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The finished photo was truly wonderful,
with bright smiles shining through all the mud—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Fufu, I've gained yet another treasure...♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, one of the photos was decided
to be displayed in the trainer's office too.
